name: EEF - Duplicate Fields
description: Provides Entity Extra Field plugins for duplicating fields with custom formatters and rendering referenced entity fields.
project_description:
EEF — Duplicate Fields extends the Entity Extra Field (entity_extra_field) module with two ExtraFieldType plugins that let site builders surface field data from the Manage Display UI without custom code.

Duplicate Field creates a virtual copy of any existing field on the same entity, rendered with an independent field-formatter configuration. Use it to display the same image at two different sizes, a date in multiple formats, or a body field with different truncation settings, all without adding redundant fields to the content model.

Entity Reference Duplicate Field renders a field from a referenced entity directly in the parent entity's display, with optional single-level chaining through a second entity reference (for example Event -> Branch -> Branch Address). It iterates every accessible referenced entity for multi-value reference fields.

Both plugins reuse core's field formatter plugins (including their third-party settings), check field and entity view access before rendering, skip empty or inaccessible values, and register config dependencies on the referenced field storage/instances so the extra field is removed cleanly when a source field is deleted.
